payload.friendly_name: Locus Foundation — Semantic Identity and Ownership
payload.purpose_context: Telos by UnknownLab has a written doctrine but no working code. This mission delivers the first executable slice of the Semantic Foundation: defining Loci with identity, purpose and a single owner, connecting them with typed relations, validating them as a set, and recording immutable revisions with change detection. It also delivers a documentation site generated from the repository's doctrine, and a playground that runs the real package so readers see genuine results with their origin shown.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make Telos's core idea real: people and agents can define a Locus, check it, track how it changes, and see real results in the docs.
